name: Consistent ordinary auto claim
expectedOutcome: No planted anomaly; still requires normal validation.

name: Conflicting incident date
expectedOutcome: Flag the date conflict for analyst review.

name: Duplicate invoice number
expectedOutcome: Flag the reused invoice identifier; do not automatically label fraud.

name: Unusually high auto amount
injectedIssues: claimAmountINR set to 950000 for an ordinary auto repair scenario
expectedOutcome: Flag for contextual review against comparable auto claims and coverage.

name: Claim outside policy coverage
injectedIssues: incidentDate moved outside policy coverage period
expectedOutcome: Flag a policy/date inconsistency; confirm policy terms before any decision.

name: Repeated claim packet
injectedIssues: same document checksum appears in two submissions
expectedOutcome: Flag identical document content for analyst review.

name: Conflicting claim amount
injectedIssues: claim form amount differs from invoice total

name: Missing required field
expectedOutcome: Flag incomplete extraction or missing data; request correction if appropriate.

name: Consistent ordinary health claim
expectedOutcome: No planted anomaly; still requires normal validation.

name: Possible narrative inconsistency
injectedIssues: description says windshield damage but claim type is Health
expectedOutcome: Ask an analyst to review the mismatch; text alone is not proof.

name: Unsupported file format
injectedIssues: document type is not PDF, JPG, JPEG or PNG
expectedOutcome: Reject or quarantine according to the configured upload policy.

name: Potential image edit
injectedIssues: synthetic test image has a planted editing indicator label; no actual model result supplied
expectedOutcome: Test fixture only: model must assess image; do not treat the planted label as model evidence.
